blurb: Guests can book piloted hot air balloon flights at scheduled times or enjoy tethered balloon rides on a first-come, first-served basis. The event includes balloon glows, food, merchandise, and children's activities. All balloon activities are weather dependent and located at the Oak Hill Property of the Virginia Horse Center in Lexington, VA.
